content: Snipe-IT status labels have a type (deployable/pending/archived/undeployable) separate from the label name itself; checkout is blocked unless the asset's current status label type is deployable, and checking an asset into a non-deployable status auto-checks it in. Check-out/check-in are core verbs: checkout marks an asset as possessed by a person/location/another asset; check-in returns it to stock. Full audit history of every checkout/checkin/status change is retained per asset.
